ee_poses.position_anchor: numerically anchored to the source Wuji Link7 EE position
ee_poses.position_warning: The source HDF5 labels xyz as a physical MANO wrist, but the stored values equal the source Wuji Link7 EE xyz. Treat Link7 as the verified anchor until a separate Link7-to-physical-wrist calibration is supplied.
ee_poses.orientation: MANO global_orient quaternion in wxyz order; not Wuji palm-to-EE orientation

ee_joint_states.warning: These are rotation vectors, not Euler xyz. Convert rotvec -> matrix -> Euler xyz for VITRA.

parameterization.translation: MANO transl is not stored; ee_poses xyz stores the fitted wrist position

temporal_contract.terminal_action: one all-NaN/invalid row per source episode is dropped

quality_scope.retained_rows: all MANO state/action leaves are finite and source validity masks are true
quality_scope.important: Finite/valid does not prove that MANO retarget residual is below a geometric threshold.

statistics_contract: mean/std are exact population aggregates; q01/q10/q50/q90/q99 follow LeRobot's frame-count-weighted aggregation of per-episode quantiles
